description: Bifolio of business accounts in Judaeo-Arabic. Bifolio of accounts in the hand of ʿArūs b. Yosef. Mentions having shipped to the elder Abū Yīṣḥaq Ibn Ṭībān a shipment of aloe and brazilwood; details the payments made for this shipment, naming Rashīd and Alexandria and "the west" (al-gharb). Mentions Saʿāda the ghulām of Ibn al-Iskandar; red fuṭas.
description_he: דפים כפולים של חשבונות עסקיים ביהודית-ערבית.
